title: Ye Kaaba poora nahi hai: Hateem (speaker-led, ~68 s)

options.visual: 0.0 s: you on screen, holding up a phone with a top-down photo of the Kaaba (real Haram aerial, free licence) that also fills the top panel. 0.6 s 'Kaaba': a thin gold square traces the Kaaba's walls on the photo. 1.2 s 'poora nahi': the square snaps open on the Hateem side and a red dashed line runs on round the half-circle wall, so the real outline is bigger than the building.
options.sound: low drone from frame 0, a pen scratch as the line draws, a soft thud when it closes round the Hateem
options.why: Frame 0 is already a thumbnail (you + the Kaaba), and the key words 'poora nahi' land on a picture that shows them inside 1.5 s.

options.layout: full-screen speaker, circle cut-out top right
options.visual: 0.0 s: you close to camera; a circle in the top right shows the Kaaba from ground level. 0.8 s: the circle grows to half the screen and a red X lands on the word 'Complete?' over it. 1.5 s: hard cut to the aerial with the Hateem lit.
options.why: Strong face-led open, but the X reads as 'something is wrong with the Kaaba', which needs care.

options.layout: split: speaker top, drawn plan below
options.visual: 0.0 s: you top half; below, a clean drawn floor plan (paper card, ink lines): a square and, beside it, the half-round wall. 1.0 s: the square's outline stretches out to swallow part of the half-circle; a label 'Kaaba?' jumps from the square to the larger shape.
options.why: Very clear and ours (no photo licence), but a drawing is weaker at frame 0 than the real Kaaba.

lines.line: Shock laga? Ye jo chhoti si half-circle wall hai na, ye bhi actually *Kaaba* hai.

options.visual: 1.8 s: the aerial pushes in on the half-round wall; pilgrims walk outside it. 3.0 s 'bahar': an arrow points from the Kaaba door side to the wall. 4.2 s 'adhi-gol': the wall's curve glows gold, the rest of the photo dims to 40%.
options.sound: drone continues, a soft chime on the glow
options.why: One push-in and one glow: a visible change every 1.2 s with the same photo, no clutter.

options.visual: Ground-level free-licence photo of pilgrims beside the Hateem wall, slow Ken Burns along the curve; you are off screen for 2 s.
options.why: Real and close, but takes you off screen inside the first 5 s.

options.layout: split: speaker top, drawn plan below
options.visual: The paper plan from 1C: the half-circle wall darkens, a small walking figure (dot) circles outside it.
options.why: Keeps to the drawn look if 1C is picked.

lines.line: Ise Hateem kehte hain. Hadith mein naam hai Hijr (الحِجْر).

options.visual: 4.8 s: the word HATEEM sets on the glowing curve in serif. 5.8 s 'Hijr': it turns over like a card to الحِجْر in Arabic with 'Hijr = the enclosed place' beside it.
options.sound: a paper flip on the turn
options.why: The term keeps its original word with the meaning beside it (CLAUDE.md), and the card flip is the change at ~6 s.

options.visual: Back to you full screen; HATEEM and الحِجْر appear as two small paper tags beside your shoulder.
options.why: Gives the face a moment, but loses the picture of the wall.

options.layout: split: speaker top, drawn plan below
options.visual: On the paper plan, a hand-lettered label 'Hateem / الحِجْر' is written along the arc.
options.why: Fits the drawn route.

lines.line: Aur ye exact sawaal Hazrat Aisha ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam se poocha tha: kya ye wall bhi Kaaba hai?

options.visual: You full screen, calm. A parchment strip slides up at the bottom with the question in English and the source line. No people drawn.
options.text: "Is this wall part of the House?"
options.why: The question the viewer now has is asked by Aisha herself; the face carries it, the parchment carries the source.

options.visual: Top: the aerial again, a question mark drawn over the curve.
options.why: Keeps the place in view; less personal.

options.visual: Hard cut: the aerial, and the red dashed outline from the hook closes round the Hateem in one stroke; the word YES stamps on it.
options.sound: a single deep thud, then silence for 0.4 s
options.why: Pays off the hook line within 15 s with the same drawing, so the viewer sees the answer.

options.visual: You nod once, YES appears beside you.
options.why: Simple, but the outline payoff is stronger.

lines.line: Toh phir ye bahar kyun hai?

options.visual: You, eyebrows up, a short pause; the aerial behind you dims and only the Hateem curve stays lit.
options.why: Lets the viewer ask the question with you before the answer.

options.visual: Top: the red outline from the hook blinks on the Hateem side.
options.why: Keeps the picture, less personal.

lines.line: Kyunki jab Quraysh ne Kaaba rebuild kiya, beech mein unka *budget* kam pad gaya.

options.visual: Below: the paper plan; stone blocks (drawn) stack up on the square, then on 'paisa' a coin pile beside it runs empty, and the last blocks for the Hateem side fade out unbuilt.
options.sound: stone knocks, coins sliding, the last coin drops alone
options.why: Shows the cause as a picture: the money ran out before the wall did.

options.visual: A desert-dusk ground, the Kaaba as a simple drawn block being built, labelled 'c. 605 CE, RECONSTRUCTION'.
options.why: Gives the time, but the year comes from sira, not this hadith.

lines.line: Aisha ne ek aur cheez notice ki. Darwaza itna *upar* kyun hai?

options.visual: Top: a real free-licence photo of the Kaaba door (Multazam side) with the wheeled stair beside it; a measuring line rises from the ground to the door sill.
options.why: The viewer has seen the stair on TV; now the height becomes a question.

options.visual: You glance up and point; the word 'Door' lifts off the bottom of the frame.
options.why: Keeps the face, but the door is the picture here.

lines.line: Reason: taaki Quraysh decide kar sakein, kaun andar jaayega aur kaun nahi. Full *control*.

options.visual: Over the door photo, two stamps: a green IN and a red NOT IN, the second stamping a little harder.
options.why: One line, one picture: power over who enters.

options.visual: A drawn stair with a gate at the top that swings open for one dot and shut for another.
options.why: Animated, but less real.

lines.line: Ab yahan interesting part aata hai. Nabi ke paas ye sab fix karne ka chance tha.

options.visual: You lean in a little, calmer voice; nothing else on screen for 1 s, then the paper plan slides in beside you.
options.why: 'Ab socho' is a talk-to-a-friend moment; the face carries it.

options.visual: The paper plan with the Quraysh square and, faint, the bigger outline it could become.
options.why: Shows the chance before the choice.

lines.line: Kaaba ko Ibrahim alaihissalam ki original foundation pe le jaate, darwaza ground level pe le aate.

options.visual: The paper plan: a faint older outline (Ibrahim's foundation) appears under the square, reaching into the Hateem; it glows warm. The fetched Ayah words ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ appear on a torn paper card with the orange 2:127 tag.
options.text: ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ · "the foundations of the House"
options.why: Ties the hadith's 'qawa'id Ibrahim' to the Quran's own word for the foundations; only the three fetched words are shown.

options.visual: The same older outline appears on the plan, no Ayah card.
options.why: Simpler if you would rather not show Quranic text here.

lines.line: Par aapne nahi kiya. Kaha: tumhare log abhi abhi jahiliyat (الجَاهِلِيَّة), yaani ignorance ke daur se nikle hain. Darr hai, unke dil ye change *accept* na karein.

options.visual: You full screen, slower, the music drops away. A parchment strip with the words in English and the source line.
options.text: "…I fear their hearts would reject it."
options.why: This is the heart of the reel; your face and quiet do the work.

options.visual: Top: the warm outline on the plan slowly fades back to the Quraysh square.
options.why: Shows the choice, but splits attention at the emotional line.

lines.line: Ek wall se zyada, unhe logon ke *dil* ki care thi.

options.visual: The real aerial of the Kaaba today, completely still for 1.5 s; the red outline and all labels gone.
options.why: A beat of stillness after the decision; the mid-video follow animation plays right after (calm moment, ~50% in).

options.visual: You, a small nod; hold 1 s.
options.why: Simple pause.

lines.line: Bas ek detail: poora Hateem Kaaba nahi. Reports mein Kaaba wala part paanch-chhe haath ka hai, matlab lagbhag *do-teen metre*.

options.visual: Below: the aerial with a scale bar; a band 2–3 m deep from the Kaaba wall into the Hateem fills gold, the rest of the half-circle stays plain. Two small labels: '5 cubits (Muslim 1333f)', '6 cubits (Bukhari 1586, Muslim 1333e)'.
options.why: The honest limit, shown at the size it really is, so nobody leaves thinking the whole Hateem was the building.

options.visual: A ruler of cubits (forearm icons) laid from the wall: 1, 2 … 6, then '≈ 3 m'.
options.why: Fun unit picture, but shows only one figure.

lines.line: Phir bhi tawaf poore Hateem ke *bahar* se hota hai.

options.visual: Real free-licence timelapse or photo of tawaf, with a soft gold path drawn round the outside of the Hateem.
options.why: Connects the history to what every pilgrim sees.

options.visual: Top: the paper plan with a dot circling outside the arc.
options.why: Fits the drawn route.

lines.line: Aur bonus: Nabi ne Aisha se kaha tha, Kaaba ke andar namaz padhni ho, toh Hateem mein padh lo.

options.visual: Top: ground photo of people praying inside the Hateem; a parchment strip with the words and source.
options.text: "Pray in the Hijr. It is part of the House."
options.why: Gives the viewer something to do with the knowledge.

options.visual: You, smiling slightly, the quote on parchment beside you.
options.why: Face-led, warmer.

lines.line: Wall *incomplete* reh gayi, taaki logon ka imaan *complete* rahe.

options.visual: The hook's aerial returns; the red dashed outline draws again but stops just short of closing; held 2 s with the line in serif.
options.why: Turns back on the hook (the outline), quotable last line held 2 s.

options.visual: You full screen, hold 2 s, the line in serif under you.
options.why: Personal, but the picture of the outline is the stronger callback.

lines.line: Koi Umrah pe jaa raha hai? Usse ye bhejo. Aur follow kar lo.

options.visual: You; the Instagram/Facebook follow animation and a send (share) icon, then the comment card: 'Have you prayed in the Hateem?'
options.text: Have you prayed in the Hateem? · Follow
options.why: Topic-tied share ask (Umrah), one comment question answerable in a word.

options.visual: End card on the aerial: follow + comment icons, the question in serif.
options.text: Have you prayed in the Hateem?
options.why: Faceless end; the face version is warmer.
